messages:
maria: Heads-up — sketching a proposal for exposing routing decision events into the Console so SRE / platform PMs can see WHY a request was routed to a specific model variant or fallback tier. thoughts?

aj: +1 we need something compact. current traces are too noisy for spike-debugging.

maria: Agreed. idea: emit a single routing_event attached to the request trace, with a short decision chain and index of applied policy. minimal fields to avoid perf hit.

derek: Can you paste an example payload? want to see token cost/privacy surface.

maria: sure — rough draft:
```json
{
  "routing_event_version": "1",
  "policy_id": "tier_priority_v2",
  "decision_chain": [
    {"step": "tier_check", "result": "dedicated", "reason": "customer_commit>=reserved"},
    {"step": "region_check", "result": "us-east-1", "reason": "closest_available"},
    {"step": "model_variant", "result": "gptx-8q", "reason": "cost_sla_balance"}
  ],
  "fallbacks": ["gptx-8q-int8","gptx-8q-32bit"],
  "applied_fallback": null,
  "route_score": 0.82
}
```

lina: This is nice. only ask: should we include the evaluated latency estimate per variant? helpful for console but maybe too heavy per-request.

maria: thinking we keep per-request minimal; store rich metrics in telemetry/aggregates. routing_event can include small numeric fields (est_latency_ms) if we need fast debugging.

kevin: two concerns: 1) PII — ensure no prompt content ever flows into this object. 2) quotas — if we start shipping these for every request, storage/egress costs could explode. maybe sample at 1% by default and 100% for canaries.

maria: yep — default sampling plan: 1% global, 100% for rollout tags + dev workspaces. plus explicit trace-on-request header: `X-Redwood-Debug:1`.

aj: For console UX: can we render a compact decision breadcrumb in the request detail flyout? like: [tier=dedicated] > [region=us-east-1] > [variant=gptx-8q] with hover for reasons.

derek: I like that. Also add a quick link to 'why fallback happened' which expands the fallback array and sampling timestamps.

maria: ops-bot: add a ticket for schema + sampling defaults and link to rollout checklist please.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-2793: "routing_event schema + console breadcrumb UX" assigned to @maria, @aj, @lina. Priority: P2. <https://tickets/redwood/INF-2793|View ticket> :white_check_mark:

lina: Last thought — internal API naming: `routing_event` vs `route_decision`. Recommend `route_decision` for consistency with existing trace fields (trace.route_*).

maria: good call. we'll rename. I'll update proto + example.

kevin: also callout in the ticket: quota meter should tag these samples separately so cost reports can attribute.

aj: ok next steps: 1) finalize proto + sampling, 2) console mock for breadcrumb + fallback panel, 3) telemetry job to aggregate per-policy hit rates. anyone want to pair on 1) this week?

derek: I can take pairing Wed afternoon. ping me before.

maria: thanks all. I'll post updated proto + small mock by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

kevin: one tiny UX ask — show variant confidence (0..1) in hover, helps explain why fallback triggered.

maria: noted. adding `route_confidence` to schema (sampled).

aj: sweet. closing loop — moving design to ticket board.

kevin: :rocket:
